name: pyang
what_it_is: pyang is a YANG validator, transformer, and code generator written in Python. It validates YANG modules for RFC compliance, converts between YANG/YIN formats, generates tree diagrams, DSDL schemas, UML diagrams, sample XML, and JSON representations via a plugin framework.
components: yang2dsdl shell script (YANG to DSDL/RELAX NG/Schematron)
XSLT stylesheets for DSDL schema generation and instance validation
Bundled IANA and IETF standard YANG modules (modules/)
protocols: SMIv2 (Structure of Management Information v2, RFC 6643)
measurement: Validation error and warning counts emitted to stderr
RFC compliance lint checks (lint.py plugin with --lint flag)
check_update plugin for detecting non-backward-compatible YANG module changes
No built-in metrics export; output is textual diagnostics
configuration: YANG_INSTALL env var: prefix directory for finding standard YANG modules
YANG_MODPATH env var: colon-separated search path for YANG modules
PYANG_XSLT_DIR env var: path to XSLT stylesheets
PYANG_RNG_LIBDIR env var: path to RELAX NG schema library
PYTHONPATH must include site-packages when installed to custom prefix
Plugin path configurable via --plugindir CLI option
Output format selected with -f <format> CLI flag
fault_injection: No built-in fault injection; pyang is a static analysis tool
check_update plugin can detect backward-incompatible changes between module revisions
modes: validate: check YANG module syntax and RFC compliance (default)
lint: stricter RFC 8407 style and guideline checks (--lint / lint plugin)
transform: convert YANG to YIN or YIN to YANG
tree: generate compact ASCII tree visualization of the data model
uml: generate PlantUML class diagram source
dsdl / yang2dsdl: translate to DSDL (RELAX NG + Schematron + DSRL) for XML instance validation
sample-xml-skeleton: generate skeleton XML instance document
sid: generate SID file for YANG module identifiers (CoAP/COMI)
flatten: flatten groupings and augments into a single module view
capability: generate NETCONF capability URI list
check_update: non-backward-compatible change detection between two module versions
constraints: Requires Python 3.7+ and lxml as the only runtime dependency
No docker-compose or containerized environment provided; must be installed via pip or source
YANG_MODPATH / YANG_INSTALL must be set correctly or standard modules will not be found when installed to a non-default prefix
yang2dsdl requires xsltproc (libxslt) and xmllint (libxml2) system binaries at runtime
Plugin framework supports custom output plugins but they must be placed in the plugins directory or on --plugindir path
SMIv2 translation (smi plugin) depends on the external libsmi library
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml or Dockerfile in the repository
No runtime NETCONF/RESTCONF server — pyang is a static analysis and transformation tool only
No GUI; all interaction is via CLI or Python library API
No built-in CI configuration beyond GitHub Actions test workflow
